doc.papyri.tess.notes: 2026-10-29: Dated by the Coptic dating rule (step 1): dated documents: the papyri are dated 600 to 699, 700 to 799 and 800 to 1099 (Coptic Scriptorium, from papyri.info); the year is the midpoint of the whole range; year 850.
